name: Paper Workflow Orchestrator Logo
design_language: Constructivism reinterpreted through Codex brand vocabulary
core_concept: A single flower-shaped mark where each petal is also a rising bar, and the center negative space forms a terminal >_ prompt. The whole shape reads as both Codex flower and research ladder.

shape.description: Seven rounded petals arranged radially. Each petal is a vertical, slightly tapered bar whose top edge rises as you move clockwise — the shortest at 7 o'clock, the tallest at 1 o'clock. The petals share edges and are not separated by gaps. Together they form a continuous flower silhouette.
shape.unified_surface: The entire flower is one continuous vector path. No strokes, no outlines, no floating elements.

color.palette: Codex blue-violet spectrum, applied as hard-edged bands (not gradients)

steps.name: bloom
steps.usage: shortest petal and adjacent left segments

steps.name: abyss
steps.usage: tallest petal and adjacent right segments

rules: Each petal is one flat color.
Color follows height: shorter = lighter violet, taller = deeper blue.
Color progression suggests research moving from idea to evidence.

terminal_symbol.description: Formed by the negative space between the two tallest petals and the central circular core.

greater_than.fill: background color (white on light, dark on dark)

terminal_symbol.note: The >_ is not drawn as a separate object. It is the hole left by the petal geometry and the core, making the symbol inseparable from the flower.

center_core.function: Holds the underscore and anchors all petals.

style.roundness: petal tips are softly rounded (radius 16px), but color boundaries are sharp

typography.font: geometric sans-serif, uppercase, medium weight, wide tracking
typography.placement: below the mark, left-aligned with the mark center

meaning.flower: Codex identity and organic growth of knowledge
meaning.rising_petals: Research stages ascending from idea to finalized paper
meaning.negative_space_prompt: Code/Codex is the invisible engine inside the research workflow

constraints: Single connected shape. No separate icons, badges, or decorations.
Every visual element must be readable as part of the same form.
Color bands are flat and geometric, not blended.
The >_ must be negative space, not an overlay.
